article.title: Seven and zero, and an injury at the top of the board
article.summary: Gravel Pit Grinders stayed unbeaten by 5.3 over the only winless team in the league, which lost Cole Vandermeer to an in-game injury. Halyard Bay Harriers took the week's upset.

sections.name: Top of the show
sections.content: Gravel Pit Grinders are 7-0, and the closest thing to a scare they have had all season came from the only winless team on the board. Sable Ridge Sentinels lost by 5.3 and lost Cole Vandermeer, who left the game hurt 38 minutes after kickoff with 6.2 points. That is the week.

sections.name: The rundown, tightest first
sections.content: Ruth Tanaka started Cole Vandermeer over Duke Ellery and it was the lineup mistake of the week: 24.1 sat on the bench behind a 6.2. Quarry Road Quakers 118.7, Milltown Mudlarks 112.3. The margin was 6.4, and Nico Barrantes had 19.7 of it back for the Quakers. Foundry District Foxes 121.4, Pike County Pilots 99.6, with Dane Kowalczyk at 27.2. Halyard Bay Harriers 127.5 over Ninth Street Nightjars 103.8 is the upset of the week: Gil Provost went for 29.9 and Tobias Reneau went for 8.1. Cedar Falls Cormorants 141.6, Ashgrove Anvils 96.4. Cass Lindqvist had 33.4 and Bo Tremaine had 4.8.

sections.name: From the sideline

quotes.speaker: Ruth Tanaka
quotes.text: I had Ellery on the bench because the injury report said questionable at noon and I did not want to risk a zero.
quotes.questionTopic: leaving Duke Ellery on the bench
quotes.writerResponse: The injury report is a real thing, and so is the one that took Cole Vandermeer out of the game. The Sentinels need a wide receiver by Sunday, and the wire is where that starts.

quotes.speaker: Ruth Tanaka
quotes.text: We lost by five. I know what that number means.
quotes.questionTopic: leaving Duke Ellery on the bench

quotes.speaker: Dana Whitlock
quotes.text: Seven and oh is a number, not a trophy.
quotes.questionTopic: starting the season seven and zero
quotes.writerResponse: Numbers desk has more on that.
